text.content: follow the suit led if you can; the highest card of it takes the trick.
each heart taken is a point, the queen of spades thirteen: keep them low.
take them all and the others get 26. at 100, the lowest score wins.
a d or the arrows pick a card, spacebar plays it, or click a card
the moon is shot: 26 to everyone else. spacebar deals
the hand is over: spacebar deals the next
